items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: A proposed policy allowing Africans to travel in Africa without a visa.
choices.zh: 一项允许非洲人在非洲境内免签旅行的拟议政策。

choices.text: An agreement among 13 African countries to set up a free-trade zone.
choices.zh: 13个非洲国家之间建立自由贸易区的协议。

choices.text: A plan to invite all African countries to join the African Union.
choices.zh: 一项邀请所有非洲国家加入非洲联盟的计划。

choices.text: An important initiative to permit tourists to visit Africa without a visa.
choices.zh: 一项允许游客免签访问非洲的重要倡议。

items.stem: What benefit will a free trade deal bring to African economy?

choices.text: It will attract more investments from all over the world.
choices.zh: 它将吸引来自世界各地的更多投资。

choices.text: It will help many African countries reduce trade deficits.
choices.zh: 它将帮助许多非洲国家减少贸易逆差。

choices.text: It will reduce the cost of trade between African countries.
choices.zh: 它将降低非洲国家之间的贸易成本。

choices.text: It will allow Africans to play a bigger role in world trade.
choices.zh: 它将使非洲人在世界贸易中发挥更大作用。

items.stem: What new method has been developed to help fight climate change?

choices.text: Cooling down volcanic rock with sea water.
choices.zh: 用海水冷却火山岩。

choices.text: Storing carbon dioxide underground as a gas.
choices.zh: 以气体形式将二氧化碳储存在地下。

choices.text: Capturing carbon dioxide and burying it under the sea.
choices.zh: 捕获二氧化碳并将其埋在海底。

choices.text: Pumping carbon dioxide underground to form stone.
choices.zh: 将二氧化碳泵入地下使其形成石头。

items.stem: What is a potential difficulty in applying the new technique?

choices.text: Lack of burying ground.
choices.zh: 缺乏掩埋场地。

choices.text: Long time for processing.
choices.zh: 处理时间长。

choices.text: High consumption of water.
choices.zh: 水消耗量大。

choices.text: Enormous cost of energy.
choices.zh: 能源成本巨大。

items.stem: What does the news report say about French people's bread consumption?

choices.text: It varies with the seasons.
choices.zh: 它随季节变化。

choices.text: It has been on the decline.
choices.zh: 它一直在下降。

choices.text: It has caused nationwide concern.
choices.zh: 它引起了全国关注。

choices.text: It is ninety grams daily on average.
choices.zh: 平均每天九十克。

items.stem: What do we learn about French women from their port?

choices.text: They emphasize food variety.
choices.zh: 她们强调食物多样性。

choices.text: They prefer French stick loaves.
choices.zh: 她们更喜欢法式长棍面包。

choices.text: They do more cooking than men.
choices.zh: 她们比男性做更多的烹饪。

choices.text: They favor diets lower in calories.
choices.zh: 她们偏爱低热量饮食。

items.stem: What is said about lifestyle changes of the French people?

choices.text: They bake more bread at home.
choices.zh: 他们在家烤更多面包。

choices.text: They spend less time eating breakfast.
choices.zh: 他们吃早餐的时间更少了。

choices.text: They eat more fruit than they used to.
choices.zh: 他们比过去吃更多水果。

choices.text: They put jam instead of butter on bread.
choices.zh: 他们在面包上涂果酱而不是黄油。

items.stem: When would the man like to leave for London?

choices.text: After the rush hour.
choices.zh: 高峰时段之后。

choices.text: Early in the morning.
choices.zh: 一大早。

choices.text: As soon as possible.
choices.zh: 越快越好。

choices.text: Around lunch time.
choices.zh: 午餐时间前后。

items.stem: What is the man's other request?

choices.text: Two first class seats.
choices.zh: 两个头等座位。

choices.text: Two seats together.
choices.zh: 两个相邻座位。

choices.text: One window seat.
choices.zh: 一个靠窗座位。

choices.text: One seat near the exit.
choices.zh: 一个靠近出口的座位。

items.stem: Where should the man wait for the train?

choices.text: In the middle of the platform.
choices.zh: 在站台中间。

choices.text: At the far end of the platform.
choices.zh: 在站台最远端。

choices.text: Behind the yellow line.
choices.zh: 在黄线后面。

choices.text: In the waiting room.
choices.zh: 在候车室。

items.stem: What should the man do to collect the bicycles?

choices.text: Wait in a queue for his turn.
choices.zh: 排队等候轮到他。

choices.text: Go to the baggage claim area.
choices.zh: 去行李提取区。

choices.text: Pay an extra fee for the service.
choices.zh: 为这项服务支付额外费用。

choices.text: Give the ticket to the train guard.
choices.zh: 把车票交给列车员。

items.stem: What do we learn about hat factories in Britain?

choices.text: Almost all of them were operating at a deficit.
choices.zh: 它们几乎全都在亏损经营。

choices.text: They have all been turned into movie theatres.
choices.zh: 它们全都已被改造成电影院。

choices.text: Nearly all of them closed down decades ago.
choices.zh: 它们几乎全都在几十年前就关闭了。

choices.text: They have adapted to meet fashion changes.
choices.zh: 它们已经适应了时尚变化。

items.stem: What is special about Cube Movie Theater?

choices.text: It shows foreign movies exclusively.
choices.zh: 它专门放映外国电影。

choices.text: It shows movies from the 1950s.
choices.zh: 它放映20世纪50年代的电影。

choices.text: It is the oldest theatre in London.
choices.zh: 它是伦敦最古老的电影院。

choices.text: It is located next to a hat factory.
choices.zh: 它位于一家帽子工厂旁边。

items.stem: What does the man say about most people in London?

choices.text: They wear hats on social occasions.
choices.zh: 他们在社交场合戴帽子。

choices.text: They don't speak foreign languages.
choices.zh: 他们不会说外语。

choices.text: They enjoy watching foreign movies.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢看外国电影。

choices.text: They don't go to movie theatres often.
choices.zh: 他们不常去电影院。

items.stem: What does the woman say about foreign movies shown in London?

choices.text: They are meant mostly for immigrants.
choices.zh: 它们主要是为移民准备的。

choices.text: They attract large crowds of young Londoners.
choices.zh: 它们吸引大批年轻的伦敦人。

choices.text: They are hard for English people to appreciate.
choices.zh: 它们对英国人来说很难欣赏。

choices.text: They have an English translation on the screen.
choices.zh: 它们在屏幕上有英文翻译。

items.stem: What do we learn about Astrid Natley, a secondary school math teacher?

choices.text: She doesn't think smartphones can replace tablets.
choices.zh: 她认为智能手机无法替代平板电脑。

choices.text: She incorporates smartphones into her teaching.
choices.zh: 她将智能手机融入她的教学中。

choices.text: She cannot stop children using smartphones.
choices.zh: 她无法阻止孩子们使用智能手机。

choices.text: She regards smartphones as a distraction.
choices.zh: 她认为智能手机会分散注意力。

items.stem: Why does Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse, support a complete ban on smartphone use in the classroom?

choices.text: To enforce school discipline.
choices.zh: 为了执行学校纪律。

choices.text: To make students concentrate.
choices.zh: 为了让学生集中注意力。

choices.text: To help children grow up to be professionals.
choices.zh: 为了帮助孩子们成长为专业人士。

choices.text: To cultivate children's good study habits.
choices.zh: 为了培养孩子们良好的学习习惯。

items.stem: What should students do in the classroom according to Richard Stone, an English teacher?

choices.text: Use books and pens only.
choices.zh: 只使用书本和笔。

choices.text: Cut down their screen time.
choices.zh: 减少他们的屏幕使用时间。

choices.text: Make full use of electronic devices.
choices.zh: 充分利用电子设备。

choices.text: Learn to use the internet for research.
choices.zh: 学习使用互联网进行研究。

items.stem: How did Kate earn the reward from her mother?

choices.text: By cleaning the kitchen floor.
choices.zh: 通过清洁厨房地板。

choices.text: By looking after her baby brother.
choices.zh: 通过照顾她的小弟弟。

choices.text: By helping her mother do the dishes.
choices.zh: 通过帮助她母亲洗碗。

choices.text: By helping her brother wash windows.
choices.zh: 通过帮助她弟弟擦窗户。

items.stem: What did Kate do after her mother left the room?

choices.text: She ordered a large number of dolls.
choices.zh: 她订购了大量娃娃。

choices.text: She checked if a purple doll was ordered.
choices.zh: 她查看是否订购了紫色娃娃。

choices.text: She mistakenly canceled her mom's order.
choices.zh: 她错误地取消了她妈妈的订单。

choices.text: She ordered a more expensive doll instead.
choices.zh: 她订购了一个更贵的娃娃。

items.stem: What did Kate's family do after the packages arrived?

choices.text: They asked the children's hospital to pick them.
choices.zh: 他们请儿童医院来取这些包裹。

choices.text: They took all of them to the children's hospital.
choices.zh: 他们把所有包裹带到了儿童医院。

choices.text: They opened all of them one by one.
choices.zh: 他们逐一打开了所有包裹。

choices.text: They discussed where to keep them.
choices.zh: 他们讨论了把这些包裹放在哪里。

items.stem: According to recent research conducted in Australia, what has a lasting impact on one's life?

choices.text: The time one starts school.
choices.zh: 一个人开始上学的时间。

choices.text: The classroom atmosphere.
choices.zh: 课堂氛围。

choices.text: The school that one attends.
choices.zh: 一个人就读的学校。

choices.text: The relationship with classmates.
choices.zh: 与同学的关系。

items.stem: What was the purpose of the Australian research?

choices.text: To help parents decide when to send their children to school.
choices.zh: 帮助家长决定何时送孩子上学。

choices.text: To find causes for differences in the participants' performance.
choices.zh: 找出参与者表现差异的原因。

choices.text: To identify students having potential to be professional athletes.
choices.zh: 识别有潜力成为职业运动员的学生。

choices.text: To offer constructive suggestions for making educational policies.
choices.zh: 为制定教育政策提供建设性建议。

items.stem: Who were the participants in the researchers' first study?

choices.text: Political leaders.
choices.zh: 政治领袖。

choices.text: Financial analysts.
choices.zh: 金融分析师。

choices.text: Professional athletes.
choices.zh: 职业运动员。

choices.text: High-school students.
choices.zh: 高中生。

items.stem: According to the researchers, what is one characteristic of successful people?

choices.text: Leadership ability.
choices.zh: 领导能力。

choices.text: Commitment to work.
choices.zh: 对工作的投入。

choices.text: Risk-taking.
choices.zh: 冒险精神。

choices.text: Self-confidence.
choices.zh: 自信。
